brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he will "change the face of the Middle East," according to Al Jazeera English. The statement reflects his government's vision for regional transformation, though Netanyahu did not elaborate on specific policies or timelines.

The comment comes amid ongoing regional tensions and Israel's military operations in Gaza and Lebanon. Netanyahu has previously outlined plans for expanded settlements and normalization agreements with Arab states as part of his broader regional strategy.
dek: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says he will ‘change the face of the Middle East’…
title: Netanyahu vows to reshape Middle East through policy
